disclaimer: Maintained executable Vite 8.2.2 toolchain scenarios; evidence verifies local build, serving, and configuration contracts without third-party framework or deployment claims.

scenarios.name: resolved_config
scenarios.description: Verifies configuration resolution, root normalization, trailing slash on base, and publicDir defaults.
scenarios.adverse_control: Unnormalized base path without trailing slash is normalized; outDir resolved cleanly

scenarios.name: env_secrecy_and_exposure
scenarios.description: Verifies that VITE_ prefixed environment variables are exposed while private secrets are strictly suppressed from client bundles.
scenarios.adverse_control: Non-VITE_ variables in .env must not appear in loadEnv client payload or built client bundle

scenarios.name: asset_public_css_alias
scenarios.description: Verifies alias resolution, unhashed publicDir asset copying, hashed imported assets, and CSS bundling.
scenarios.adverse_control: Unresolvable alias rejects build; public assets remain at root unhashed

scenarios.name: plugin_ordering_and_apply
scenarios.description: Verifies plugin pre/post ordering, conditional apply (build vs serve), and virtual module resolution.
scenarios.adverse_control: Plugin applied only to serve does not execute during build; pre hooks execute before post hooks

scenarios.name: loopback_dev_fs_restrictions
scenarios.description: Verifies dev server loopback binding, strict fs allow list, and HTTP 403 rejection for denied files or traversal.
scenarios.adverse_control: Requesting file in server.fs.deny or traversing outside allowed directory returns HTTP 403 Forbidden

scenarios.name: hmr_module_invalidation
scenarios.description: Verifies module graph tracking and module invalidation mechanics on the dev server.
scenarios.adverse_control: Cached module graph node transformResult cleared upon invalidation

scenarios.name: production_manifest
scenarios.description: Verifies production build with Rolldown and generation of .vite/manifest.json mapping entries to hashed files.

scenarios.name: dynamic_import_and_library_mode
scenarios.description: Verifies dynamic import chunk splitting and library mode building for dual ESM/CJS distributions.
scenarios.adverse_control: Dynamic import must produce separate chunk; library mode emits configured formats

scenarios.name: sourcemap_toggle
scenarios.description: Verifies explicit sourcemap generation when enabled and total absence of map files when disabled.
scenarios.adverse_control: build.sourcemap: false must not emit any .map files or sourceMappingURL comments

scenarios.name: preview_local_only
scenarios.description: Verifies preview server loopback binding and local serving of generated production build.
scenarios.adverse_control: Preview server strictly serves built files on loopback; closes without leaking socket

scenarios.name: two_builds_determinism
scenarios.description: Verifies bit-for-bit or SHA-256 digest identity across two consecutive builds from identical source state.
scenarios.adverse_control: Any non-deterministic artifact or timestamp variation fails the digest match

scenarios.name: misconfiguration_negatives
scenarios.description: Verifies fail-closed error handling and clean rejection of missing library entry and misconfigured input options.
scenarios.adverse_control: Missing library entrypoint or broken input configuration throws descriptive UNRESOLVED_ENTRY error rather than corrupting build
